title: Dan Quinn expects more of Jayden Daniels under center with David Blough calling offensive plays

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Quinn expects more of Jayden Daniels under center with David Blough calling offensive plays
sources.description: The Commanders will have a new offensive coordinator in 2026 and head coach Dan Quinn said at a Tuesday press conference that he expects some new wrinkles with David Blough calling the team's plays.
